name: sentry_flutter
summary: The Sentry SDK for Flutter, providing error monitoring and observability across supported Flutter targets.
advantages: Supports a broad set of Flutter targets
Can align mobile error monitoring with an organization-wide Sentry setup
tradeoffs: Adds an external observability service and SDK configuration
Feature set and platform integrations should be checked against project monitoring requirements
recommendedFor: Apps that want cross-platform error monitoring beyond a Firebase-only stack
Teams already using Sentry across backend, web, or mobile systems

verification.reason: Current Sentry documentation and pub.dev metadata are sufficient; 10.0.0 remains prerelease.
